positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Classes: 
- Problem Solving with Computers II (CMPSC 24)
- Data Structures & Algorithms (CMPSC 130A / 130B)
Lead lab sections, graded student work, built auto-grading tools for coding assignments (via Gradescope)

positions.title: Sensor Intern
positions.description:
Updated and streamlined pytest collection and testing frameworks to reduce automated test runtime.
Worked with team to build end-to-end framework to support more robust product testing.

positions.title: IT Operations Intern
positions.description:
Developed applications for company-wide use to automate access request processes using Microsoft PowerApps, Power Automate, and SharePoint.
Supported software help desk tickets; implemented an automated ticket help solution (Zendesk Answer Bot) to direct users towards resolutions to common questions.

positions.title: Automation Testing Assistant
positions.description:
Created and executed automated tests for Arlo's Android, iOS, and Web applications using Katalon Studio, a UI automation tool built on top of Selenium and Appium. 
Developed a resource manager with Python and MySQL database to dynamically allocate test accounts, mobile phones, and Arlo devices to the automated test runs.

positions.title: Code Coach
positions.description: Summer Camp Instructor and Code Coach. Taught elementary and middle school students Python, Java, Scratch, and Construct 3 in both group and personalized educational settings.

honors.title: Dean's Honors
honors.description: Recognition for consistently strong academic performance.
honors.issuer: Issued by College of Engineering, UC Santa Barbara · Jul 2019

honors.title: UC Regents Scholar
honors.description: The Regents Scholarship is the highest merit-based honor given to incoming University of California students based on a wholistic selection process reviewing test scores, grades, academic preparation, and their overall admissions application.
honors.issuer: Issued by Regents of the University of California · May 2018
